description: Kvlar v0.3.0 — structured errors, approval webhooks, Python SDK, production hardening

userStories.title: Publish v0.2.0 crates to crates.io
userStories.description: Publish all 4 workspace crates (kvlar-audit, kvlar-core, kvlar-proxy, kvlar-cli) at v0.2.0 to crates.io so users can install via cargo install.
acceptanceCriteria: All 4 crates published to crates.io at v0.2.0
cargo install kvlar-cli installs v0.2.0
No publish errors or dependency issues
userStories.notes: Published in dependency order: kvlar-audit, kvlar-core, kvlar-proxy, kvlar-cli. All 4 at v0.2.0.

userStories.title: Structured error responses with machine-readable denial reasons
userStories.description: Add structured error detail types to kvlar-core so denial reasons include error codes, categories, and matched rule metadata. This enables programmatic error handling by agents and integrations.
acceptanceCriteria: ErrorDetail struct with code, category, rule_id, message fields
PolicyDecision::Deny and RequireApproval carry ErrorDetail
Proxy returns structured JSON error in MCP tool result isError responses
Existing tests updated, new tests for error detail serialization
cargo test --workspace passes
cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
userStories.notes: ErrorDetail struct in kvlar-core, _kvlar metadata in proxy responses. 6 new tests.

userStories.title: Human approval webhook — core types and ApprovalBackend trait
userStories.description: Define the core types and trait for human approval in kvlar-core. When a policy evaluates to RequireApproval, the system needs a way to request and await human decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: ApprovalRequest struct (request_id, action, rule_id, reason, timestamp)
ApprovalResponse enum (Approved, Denied with optional reason)
ApprovalBackend trait with async request_approval method
Types are serializable (serde Serialize/Deserialize)
cargo test --workspace passes
cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
userStories.notes: ApprovalRequest/ApprovalResponse in kvlar-core (pure). ApprovalBackend trait + DenyAllApprovalBackend in kvlar-proxy. Boxed futures for dyn safety.

userStories.title: Human approval webhook — HTTP webhook transport
userStories.description: Implement an HTTP webhook ApprovalBackend that POSTs approval requests to a configured URL and polls/receives the decision.
acceptanceCriteria: WebhookApprovalBackend implements ApprovalBackend trait
Sends POST with ApprovalRequest JSON to configured webhook URL
Supports configurable timeout (default 5 minutes)
Supports callback mode (webhook POSTs back) and poll mode (proxy polls endpoint)
Proxy integrates approval flow: RequireApproval -> webhook -> await -> forward or deny
CLI --approval-webhook flag to configure webhook URL
cargo test --workspace passes
cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
userStories.notes: WebhookApprovalBackend uses reqwest. Synchronous request-response pattern. Handler integrates approval flow for RequireApproval decisions. CLI --approval-webhook and --approval-timeout flags.

userStories.title: Python SDK — ADR and subprocess wrapper
userStories.description: Write an ADR for the Python SDK approach, then implement a subprocess-based Python wrapper that shells out to the kvlar binary.
acceptanceCriteria: ADR document at docs/adr/adr-005-python-sdk.md
Python package structure at sdks/python/kvlar/
KvlarEngine class that wraps kvlar CLI subprocess calls
evaluate() method that takes action dict and returns decision
test_policy() method that runs kvlar test
Basic pytest test suite passing
pyproject.toml with package metadata
userStories.notes: ADR-005 written. KvlarEngine subprocess wrapper with evaluate(), test_policy(), validate(). 18 pytest tests passing. Package at sdks/python/.

userStories.title: Integration tests with real MCP server
userStories.description: Add integration tests that spin up a real MCP server (filesystem server), proxy it through Kvlar, and verify end-to-end policy enforcement.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test module in kvlar-proxy/tests/
Tests spawn @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem via npx
Test: allowed tool call passes through and returns real result
Test: denied tool call is blocked and returns error
Test: require_approval tool call is blocked pending approval
Tests are marked #[ignore] by default (require npx/node)
CI workflow runs ignored tests in a separate job with Node.js
cargo test --workspace passes (ignored tests don't break default run)
userStories.notes: 4 integration tests in kvlar-proxy/tests/mcp_integration.rs. Spawn real @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem via npx. Tests: allow passthrough, deny blocked, require_approval blocked, non-tool-call passthrough. All #[ignore] by default.

userStories.title: Graceful shutdown and signal handling
userStories.description: Handle SIGTERM/SIGINT gracefully — drain active connections, flush audit logs, and exit cleanly. Critical for Docker/K8s deployments.
acceptanceCriteria: SIGTERM and SIGINT handlers installed on proxy startup
Active tool call evaluations complete before shutdown
Audit log is flushed before exit
Upstream child process (stdio mode) is terminated cleanly
Shutdown timeout (default 30s) force-kills if drain takes too long
Log message on graceful shutdown: 'shutting down...'
cargo test --workspace passes
cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
userStories.notes: shutdown.rs module with signal_shutdown_token() using CancellationToken. StdioTransport and McpProxy both integrate signal-aware shutdown. AuditLogger.flush() added. 3 new tests, 112 total.

userStories.title: Comprehensive error handling and health check endpoint
userStories.description: Add robust error handling for proxy pipeline failures (upstream timeout, disconnect, malformed messages) and a /health endpoint for liveness probes.
acceptanceCriteria: Upstream disconnect: proxy returns error to agent, logs event, does not crash
Upstream timeout: configurable timeout (default 60s), returns timeout error to agent
Malformed JSON-RPC: proxy returns parse error, continues processing
Health check: GET /health returns 200 OK with JSON status (for TCP mode)
Health check includes: uptime, policy_loaded, rules_count, requests_evaluated
cargo test --workspace passes
cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
userStories.notes: health.rs module with ProxyStats (atomics), HealthStatus JSON, run_health_server (raw HTTP). Error handling: parse_error_response for malformed JSON-RPC, upstream_error_response for disconnects. --health CLI flag. 5 new tests, 117 total.
